issues.description: Farm.singFarmSong() and the helper singFarmSongVerse(Animal) have conflicting return types/behaviour across artifacts. The problem statement (UML and text) and the template declare/expect singFarmSong() to print the song (void behavior) and the template provides a private void singFarmSongVerse(/*Animal animal*/) helper that prints lines (template signature at Farm.java line 18). The solution implementation instead makes both methods return String: singFarmSong() returns String (solution Farm.java line 59) and singFarmSongVerse(Animal) returns String (solution Farm.java line 33). This mismatch (print/void vs return/String) is a structural contradiction that will confuse students about whether they should implement printing in the method or return the song text, and it can lead to test/signature mismatches.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the contract for these methods across all artifacts. Two reasonable options: (A) Align to the problem statement and template: change the solution methods to void and perform printing inside singFarmSong() / singFarmSongVerse(Animal). Update the solution Farm.java so singFarmSong() has signature public void singFarmSong() and singFarmSongVerse(Animal) is private void singFarmSongVerse(Animal), and use System.out.println to print verses (then update any tests expecting returned String). Preferred for minimal changes to the template/problem text. OR (B) Change the problem statement (UML and textual description), the template Farm.java signatures, and any tests to specify that singFarmSong() returns String (and singFarmSongVerse returns String) and update the template comments accordingly. Apply the chosen approach consistently in template, problem statement, solution, and tests.
